summary: Lassen NF lookout in Tehama County, CA; built 1936, removed after 1984 but before 1986; a bridge below the site reopened in 2017.

facts.design: Unusual design; coded 'C4' in a 1986 Thornton survey (per the register)
facts.status_note: Register says removed after 1984 but before 1986. No source describes remains at the site; a Forest Road bridge lies below it.

corrections.proposed: after 1984 but before 1986 (no exact year given)
corrections.why: Register says 'After 1984 but before 1986'. 1986 is the upper bound of that range, not the year of removal, so no removal event is recorded.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register dates removal to after 1984 but before 1986, yet cites a 1986 survey for the C4 code. The range is kept and no single removal year is recorded. The survey entry is not taken as proof the building stood in 1986.

notes_for_editor: Location conflict is not resolved. The register says the building stood right next to Highway 32. The 2017 Chico article puts the Windy Cut Bridge, which lies below the site, six miles down a dirt road from Highway 32, so the lookout may have stood far from the highway. Record said removed 1986; the register gives only a range, so the removal event was dropped (see corrections). Register captions a December 1961 photo credited to Meriam Library, California State University, Chico. The image URL was not captured, so no photos entry was added. A firelookout.org Tehama list row near Windy Cut carries a number (US 1327, CA 150) that matches another lookout on the NHLR; not used. Site access is not described in any source read; the bridge reopened in 2017.
